hero.summary_en: The 2026 Champ de Mars calendar is automatically routed at rank C from licensed Supertote after a live GRA horseracing-context check; MTCJC remains reviewed manual context because its current pages challenge GitHub Actions.
hero.summary_ja: 2026年Champ de Mars日程は、GRAの現行競馬文脈を確認したうえでlicensed SupertoteからCで自動取得します。MTCJC現行ページはGitHub Actionsをchallengeするため、レビュー済み手動文脈として維持します。

paragraphs_en: Production automation preserves the Gambling Regulatory Authority, MTC Jockey Club, and Automatic Systems Ltd / Supertote as separate roles. GRA supplies live regulatory context, Supertote supplies the automation-safe 2026 meeting calendar, and MTCJC remains the reviewed organiser context but is not used as the GitHub Actions runner while Cloudflare challenge is active.
paragraphs_ja: production自動取得ではGambling Regulatory Authority、MTC Jockey Club、Automatic Systems Ltd / Supertoteを別役割として維持します。GRAは現行規制文脈、Supertoteは自動取得可能な2026年開催日程、MTCJCはレビュー済み主催者文脈として扱い、Cloudflare challenge中はGitHub Actions runnerには使いません。
